comments.author: dzole0311
comments.body:
@sandesh-sp thanks for the input! 

> 2. Only expose some of the configurations that are relevant to user and directly modify mission config json file for the rest (for the September deliverable)

Just to make sure I understand opt 2 correctly. For the September deliverable, we could show a minimal set of fields in the UI for deck.gl for example only the Core tab with name, URL and type. For everything else, users would edit the mission config json directly. Then we incrementally expose more tabs and fields as we validate what each one means in the deck.gl context. Does that sound right?

> I created a new field for layout/styling called mission mode which can be either 'classic' or 'modern'. Both mode and renderer will impact which tabs (and sections within it) will be present on the configuration page.

Is that already in one of the branches / still in progress? I have not seen it in the codebase yet.

> We should also decide if we will be creating on our own tool builder on top of MMGIS core instead of relying on the configuration page in future. And if yes, will that impact the modifications we'll be making on current configuration page.

I may be missing some context here but from what I've seen so far i'd be in favor of going that route since we could likely do it much better than extending the existing configure page. I'm just not sure whether it should be prioritized before the September deliverable. It seems better to get the basics working first and revisit it afterwards (or start in parallel if there's bandwidth?). What do you think?
